title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain CUNY Queens College
description: A guide to the essential late-night food stops for CUNY Queens College students, from 24-hour diners to campus-adjacent pizza and halal spots.

cards.title: 24-Hour Bagel Runs
cards.subtitle: Bagel Oasis
cards.notes: Visit this 24/7 institution for hand-rolled bagels and spreads. It is a primary late-night destination for students living in Fresh Meadows or commuting via the LIE.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour bagel shop on the Horace Harding Expressway known for traditional hand-rolled bagels.
cards.evidence_claim: Bagel Oasis is open 24 hours, 7 days a week at 183-12 Horace Harding Expressway.
cards.source_title: The 21 Best 24-Hour Restaurants in NYC for Your Round-the-Clock Cravings

cards.title: Midnight Coffee and Donuts
cards.subtitle: Dunkin' at 153-67 Horace Harding Expy
cards.notes: Stop by this 24-hour location near the north edge of campus for a late-night caffeine fix or a quick snack during overnight study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Dunkin' and Baskin-Robbins location situated directly across from the Queens College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 15367 Horace Harding Expy in Flushing is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 15367 Horace Harding Expy in Flushing | Coffee & Donuts Near You

cards.title: The Campus Halal Cart
cards.subtitle: Shah's Halal at 65-30 Kissena Blvd
cards.notes: Grab a platter of chicken or lamb over rice at this campus staple. It serves as a reliable evening food source for students leaving late classes.
cards.short_summary: A popular halal food cart and storefront located at the intersection of Kissena Blvd and Horace Harding Expressway.
cards.evidence_claim: Shah's Halal Food has a location at 65-30 Kissena Blvd & Horace Harding Expy, serving the Queens College community.
cards.source_title: Food Trucks & Carts - Shahs Halal Food
cards.access_notes: Typically open until 10:00 PM or later depending on campus activity.

cards.title: Post-Class Pizza Slices
cards.subtitle: Gino's of Kissena
cards.notes: Show your student ID for a discount on slices and rolls. This pizzeria is a frequent stop for commuters heading to the bus stops on Kissena Blvd.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood pizzeria located just outside the Queens College campus gates.
cards.evidence_claim: Gino's of Kissena is located at 65-01 Kissena Blvd and offers a 10% discount to students with ID.
cards.source_title: Gino's Pizza – The Best Pizza in Flushing
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:30 PM Wednesday through Saturday; 9:00 PM other nights.

cards.title: The 24/7 Dorm Snack Run
cards.subtitle: The Summit Apartments Lobby
cards.notes: Access quick meals like ramen or yogurt at any hour. These machines are the primary late-night food source for residents within the campus gates.
cards.short_summary: Vending machines located in the lobby of the on-campus residence hall, providing 24-hour food and drink access.
cards.evidence_claim: Vending machines at The Summit are located off the main lobby and are available 24 hours per day, offering snacks and quick meals like ramen.
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 for residents; lobby access may be restricted for non-residents late at night.

cards.title: Late-Night Glatt Kosher
cards.subtitle: Pita Hot - Pomonok
cards.notes: Order a shawarma platter or falafel wrap at this Glatt Kosher spot on Main Street. It is a key late-night option for the campus's large Jewish community.
cards.short_summary: A Glatt Kosher Mediterranean restaurant on Main Street frequently visited by Queens College students.
cards.evidence_claim: Pita Hot at 75-43 Main St is open until 11:00 PM on most weeknights.
cards.source_title: Order Pita Hot - Pomonok Delivery Online
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM Sunday-Thursday; closes early on Fridays for Shabbat.

cards.title: The Main Street Chicken Stop
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Fried Chicken
cards.notes: Head to Main Street for fried chicken, gyros, and burgers. This spot is known for staying open well past midnight for the local student population.
cards.short_summary: A classic NYC late-night fried chicken and fast food outlet located on Main Street near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Kennedy Fried Chicken is a go-to for late night food in the area, with some locations in Flushing open until 3:00 AM or 4:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Open late daily, often until 3:00 AM.

cards.title: Chicken Finger Cravings
cards.subtitle: Raising Cane's on Main Street
cards.notes: Take the Q25 or Q34 bus down Main Street for a late-night Box Combo. This newer addition to Flushing is a popular destination for student groups.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food chain specializing in chicken fingers, located in the heart of Flushing.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's at 39-20 Main Street is open until 3:00 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Flushing, NY, - 39-20 Main Street
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM Sunday-Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: The Kissena Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: McDonald's at 72-69 Kissena Blvd
cards.notes: Visit the closest major fast-food chain to the south end of campus. It is a standard late-night stop for students with cars or those walking from the dorms.
cards.short_summary: A standard McDonald's location with a drive-thru, situated just south of the Queens College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 7269 Kissena Blvd is a primary late-night food option near campus.
cards.source_title: Best Restaurants Near Me in Queens

cards.title: The 24/7 Convenience Run
cards.subtitle: 7-Eleven on Main Street
cards.notes: Stock up on snacks, drinks, or hot food at any hour. This location serves as a reliable fallback when other local eateries have closed for the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store located on Main Street, providing essential late-night supplies for students.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven locations in the Queens area are typically open 24/7, providing snacks and hot food.
